name: Hot Potato
hook: Pass the ticking potato. Don't hold it when it blows.
how: Whoever holds the hot potato passes it by touching someone, and nobody knows when it will go off. Holding it at the bang knocks you out; the last one left wins.
controls: WASD or arrow keys and Space to dash, or the touch stick and Dash button
uses: The host's browser deals the potato, sets its fuse and decides every pass; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill the garden until enough people join, and chase or run like players.
Everyone sees the same potato in the same hands at the same moment.
The players who won the most games, on the results card.
ideas: Make it a snowball fight in a snowy park
Add a second potato when there are lots of players
Add speed boots that appear on the grass
